answer.reason: Besides the town lists, the verses tell of Jattir being given to the priests and of David sending spoil to its people.

clauses.english: was given with its suburbs to the sons of Aaron
clauses.quote: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah

clauses.english: was sent a share of David's spoil from the enemies of the LORD
clauses.quote: and to them which were in Jattir

doubts: 2SA 23:38 and 1CH 11:40 name Ira and Gareb the Ithrites, which does not concern the town of Jattir, so they were left out.
JOS 15:48 only lists the town among those in the mountains, so it was not used.
